verdict.rationale: IP India is a government IP-office portal offering e-filing, public search, status tracking and publications. Recurring scheduled searches or status-watch workflows are a plausible capability for this kind of service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no scheduling, recurring-job or automated-workflow feature. Dynamic cause lists and status lookups are one-off, on-demand views, not user-defined recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
